summary: Line A2 investigation opened and a fixed discriminating experiment submitted: raft's VerifyLeader confirms leadership with acknowledgements from any replica (notifyAll(true) -> verifyFuture.vote) while its quorum size counts only voters, so a leader that can reach only a Nonvoter may report success without a voter quorum. The harness builds a real 4-node in-memory cluster, moves one follower voter->non-voter via DemoteVoter, partitions the leader from the two remaining voters keeping only that node reachable, and calls VerifyLeader; two controls change exactly one property each (same reachable node still a voter; non-voter unreachable). Native local execution reproduced the predicted asymmetry (nil vs 'leadership lost while committing log'); formal evidence awaits the controller's retained execution, after which the interpretation and the bounded-stale-window gap will be recorded.
